meta.title: Create a Category and Sub-Categories
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Create a Category and Sub-Categories".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Create a Category and Sub-Categories', 'joomlaguide-category', '

Categories give your articles structure, like the chapters of a book. Each article is in one category.

In this tour you:

  1. create a category Company with two sub-categories, Team and Locations
  2. move the article Company Overview into Company
  3. add an article to each sub-category

This tour follows the tutorial 2.2 Creating a Category and Sub-Category of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_categories"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 2.2 Creating a Category and Sub-Category', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Content › Categories', '

Click Categories in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Create a new category', '

This is the list of the categories of your articles.

Click New to start a new category.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-categories .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Give the category a title', '

Type a title for the category, for example:

Company

When you have typed it, click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-category #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save the category', '

Click Save & Close.

Joomla saves the category and takes you back to the list of categories.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-category #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Add a sub-category', '

Company is now in the list.

Next, you add sub-categories to it. Click New.

', 6, 'bottom', 'body.view-categories:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Title of the sub-category', '

Type the title:

Team

Then click Next.

', 7, 'bottom', '.view-category #jform_title', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Choose the Parent', '

The Parent makes this category a sub-category of another one.

Click the field Parent and choose Company.

Then click Next.

', 8, 'left', '.view-category fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_parent_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Open the save options', '

You want to create another sub-category right away. Click the arrow next to Save & Close.

', 9, 'bottom', '.view-category #toolbar-dropdown-save-group .dropdown-toggle-split', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save & New', '

Click Save & New.

Joomla saves the category and opens a new, empty form.

', 10, 'left', '.view-category #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'The second sub-category', '

Type the title:

Locations

When you have typed it, click Next.

', 11, 'bottom', 'body.view-category:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Choose the Parent', '

Choose Company as Parent here too.

Then click Next.

', 12, 'left', '.view-category fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_parent_id)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save the category', '

Click Save & Close.

', 13, 'bottom', 'body.view-category:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Your categories', '

Team and Locations are shown indented below Company: they are its sub-categories.

Next, you put articles in these categories.

', 14, 'top', '#categoryList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 15, 'right', 'body.com_categories.view-categories #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Open Company Overview', '

You can move an article you wrote earlier into a category.

Click Company Overview to open it.

', 16, 'right', '.view-articles a[title$=" Company Overview"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Choose the Category', '

Click the field Category and choose Company.

Then click Next.

', 17, 'left', '.view-article fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_catid)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 18, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'An article for each sub-category', '

Company Overview is now in the category Company.

An empty sub-category does not show much. Add an article to each one: click New.

', 19, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Title of the article', '

Type the title:

Meet the Team

When you have typed it, click Next.

', 20, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Choose the Category', '

Click the field Category and choose Team. It is shown with a dash, below Company.

Then click Next.

', 21, 'left', '.view-article fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_catid)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Write the text', '

Type the text of the article in the editor, for example:

Our team brings together experienced professionals from across the industry, united by a shared commitment to quality.

Then click Next.

', 22, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Open the save options', '

Click the arrow next to Save & Close.

', 23, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-dropdown-save-group .dropdown-toggle-split', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save & New', '

Click Save & New.

Joomla saves the article and opens a new, empty form.

', 24, 'left', '.view-article #save-group-children-save-new .button-save-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'The second article', '

Type the title:

Our Locations

When you have typed it, click Next.

', 25, 'bottom', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Choose the Category', '

Choose the category Locations.

Then click Next.

', 26, 'left', '.view-article fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_catid)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Write the text', '

Type the text, for example:

We operate offices in multiple cities, each staffed by local experts ready to help.

Then click Next.

', 27, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 28, 'bottom', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-category'), 'Well done!', '

You now have a small but real structure: Company holds Company Overview, and its sub-categories Team and Locations each hold an article.

The column Category shows where each article is. In the next tutorial you make menu items that show these categories on your site.

', 29, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
